title: Attachment digest v1 (vessel_issues_mail_attachments)
description: One document per DISTINCT FILE, keyed by the SHA-256 of the fetched bytes. The same file arriving on several mails (or several casefiles) is one document with several links[]. This is the store that provenance.attachment_shas in the casefile extract (casefile_extract.v2) points at: every sha cited there must exist here, with a link on one of the cited mails. Digest fields are read from the file itself (PDF text / OCR / vision for scans, docx and xlsx text, .eml body) and never from the mail that carried it. Non content-bearing files (signature logos, banners) still get a document - with content_bearing false and no digest - so the junk decision is recorded once and never re-made.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the fetched bytes. The identity; unique index.

links.description: Every place this file appeared. One entry per (mail, url); appended when the same sha is seen again, never duplicated.

mailbodyId.description: pages[].referenceId of the mail that carried it.

attachment_name.description: URL-decoded file name as it appeared on that mail.

content_bearing.description: False for files with no case content: signature logos, banners, decorative images, calendar/contact files. When false, summary is null and maker/model/equipment_details are "NA".

kind_of_doc.description: Document class, e.g. 'Service report', 'Statement of Facts (SOF)', 'Defect report (C/E)', 'Invoice', 'Air waybill', 'Email signature / logo image', 'Identity document - passport', 'Telemetry dump / archive (not opened)'.

summary.description: What the document contains, 1-3 sentences, from the file itself. null when not content-bearing. Identity documents: classify only, never summarise numbers.

tags.description: Closed list, from config (e.g. service_report, sof, defect_report, quotation, invoice, logistics, running_in_procedure, drawing, photo_report). Not free text.

maker.description: Equipment maker stated in THIS document, else "NA". Never inferred.

model.description: Equipment model/type stated in THIS document, else "NA".

equipment_details.description: Equipment, components, part numbers, running hours, failure detail stated in THIS document, else "NA".

extracted_text.description: The text the digest was read from (PDF text layer, OCR output, docx/xlsx text, .eml body), inline when small. The validator matches evidence_quote against it. null when text_ref is used or the file has no text (image, archive).

text_ref.description: Pointer to the extracted text when it is too large to inline (object-store key). Exactly one of extracted_text / text_ref is non-null for a content-bearing text document.

extraction_method.description: How the digest was produced. listed_only for archives/dumps (name and member list recorded, not opened); skipped for non content-bearing files.
